blocks.title: Bootstrap the slope
blocks.md:
Bootstrap the slope of the regression of `Age` on `Diameter` in `trees.csv` (made-up) with 2,000 resamples of
rows. Print the 95% CI (3 decimals) and whether it contains 0. Expected output:

```text
95% CI: 0.443 0.632
contains 0: False
```

blocks.title: Ready when I can…
items: Bootstrap a CI for the slope.

blocks.title: Solution: Bootstrap the slope
blocks.md:
Full program for **Bootstrap the slope** (try it yourself first):

```python
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

t = pd.read_csv("trees.csv")
np.random.seed(1330)

def slope_of(df):
    r = np.corrcoef(df["Diameter"], df["Age"])[0, 1]
    return r * np.std(df["Age"]) / np.std(df["Diameter"])

slopes = []
for i in range(2000):
    resample = t.sample(len(t), replace=True)
    slopes.append(slope_of(resample))

left = np.percentile(slopes, 2.5)
right = np.percentile(slopes, 97.5)
print("95% CI:", round(left, 3), round(right, 3))
print("contains 0:", left <= 0 <= right)
```

Output:

```text
95% CI: 0.443 0.632
contains 0: False
```
